items.title: The Perfect Bite
items.summary: The Perfect Bite , presented by Secret City in collaboration with Netflix , brings its sold-out murder mystery dinner experience to Mississauga, inspired by the thrilling world of Netflix's Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery. Step into an exclusive culinary event hosted by acclaimed Chef Maribelle Moore , where a delicious four-course meal quickly becomes the scene of a gripping mystery . Interact with live actors, uncover secrets, and become part of the story as the evening unfolds around you.

items.title: The BFUTR Global Tech Summit 2026
items.summary: November 19 @ 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM EST November 20 @ 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM EST BFUTR 2026 brings together technology professionals, industry leaders, employers and innovators for two days of conversations, career opportunities, networking and learning at the International Centre in Mississauga. Under this year’s theme, Reprogramming the Enterprise: Technology, Talent & Leadership , BFUTR will explore how emerging technologies, evolving talent strategies and new approaches to leadership are reshaping the future of work and business.

items.title: An Evening of Piano: A City in Tune Exhibition
items.summary: Experience an unforgettable evening of live music at the historic Adamson Estate, where the stories and artists featured in A City in Tune will come to life through a special after-hours performance. The evening will feature award-winning Mississauga vocalist Heather Christine and acclaimed Canadian pianist Bill King , whose talents and contributions to the music community make them ideal performers to celebrate the exhibition.

items.title: Christmas Canadian Pet Expo

items.title: ORC Christmas Market
items.summary: The Ontario Racquet Club Christmas Market is back! Join us for the 3rd Annual ORC Christmas Market for a festive day of holiday shopping, local finds, and seasonal cheer. We’re excited to welcome 45 local vendors offering handmade treasures, unique gifts, festive finds, and plenty of holiday inspiration. Whether you’re getting a head start on your Christmas shopping, looking for something special, or simply want to enjoy a festive morning out, there will be something for everyone!
